Las Vegas: Antelope Canyon (Upper or Lower or X), Horseshoe Bend Tour With Lunch
(88 Reviews)
 Code: LV1-8649
 Day Tour
 Las Vegas
What To Expect
Overview
Exclusive tour visiting Antelope Canyon at noon time, have an in-depth experience to enjoy incredible color changing inside Upper Antelope Canyon.
Shoot the best photos in your Insgram and Facebook, making your friends feel jealous.
Lower Antelope Canyon, One of the weirdest 20 tourist destinations in the world.
Climb upside down in Lower Antelope Canyon to have an unforgetable adventure.
Watch the extraordinary creation of nature - U shaped channel Horseshoe Bend
Well-designed journey and VIP services, letting you fully immerse into the amazing view of western world.

Assemble: Departure around 6:00 AM. Please come to the entrance of the designated hotel in advance, see detailed pickup and starting point information.

Outline of itinerary: In the early morning, we drive to Page City of Arizona, and visit the U channel Horseshoe Bend first. Then we go to Antelope Canyon and enter at the best time (normally from 11am to 14pm) to explore the magical world.

After the magical journey, we returned to Las Vegas.

Time arrangement:

1. Horseshoe bend Tour: 40 minutes

2. Antelope Canyon Tour: 1-2 hours(Lower Antelope Canyon / Canyon X, based on the selection at the time of booking)

 Lunch
 End Time: Las Vegas local time 20:00 (for reference only)

Terms & Conditions
What is the cancellation policy?

Non-refundable reservations cannot be cancelled or modified once submitted.

What if you miss the appointed time or departure date?

Once the booking is confirmed, an absence or failure to show up on the scheduled date or time is a no-show. No refunds or reschedules will be issued for no-shows and late arrivals.

Other important information
Please make sure to bring your official ID, for hotel check in and Antelope Canyon check in, and enough cash, for any optional items and tour guide tips. All optional items purchased on the tour require cash payment.
Please keep valuables together with you instead of leaving in the vehicle.
Under certain circumstances, such as accidents, bad weather and vehicle damage, tour company has the right to delay, change or cancel the reserved tour.
All passengers need to follow the guidance of tour guide. If you want to leave the tour before it ends or do some personal activities, please inform your tour guide in advance. Tour guide and tour company won’t take any responsibilities for your personal activities. We don’t recommend you act along at anytime.
Tour prices on certain days, mostly holidays, might be adjusted. Please consult our customer service before you book.
You are required to arrive the specified pick-up location at least 10 mins prior to the pick-up time. If you are late, no matter for what reasons, the tour guide has the right to forbidding you joining the tour. No refund will be issued.
Since the space of the vehicle is limited and sometimes we need to pass through security, each visitors can only bring one backpack. You can leave your other luggage in the hotel.
Please be noticed since this is VIP tour for a small group of visitors, tour guide and driver will be the same person. Normally he or she won’t walk together with the group into some attractions.
Under the basis of not reducing the number of attractions and the time of visiting, tour guide has the right to adjust the tour schedule based on the actual situation.
If you plan to leave the tour by yourself at a certain poin, please let us know when booking to confirm if it can be arranged or not.
Passengers are required to fasten their seat belts all the time in the vehicle.
We need at least 4 visitors to form a group. If there are fewer than 4 visitors in the group, your order won’t be confirmed. You can require cancellation and refund at any time.
In the actual trip, on the premise of not reducing the number of scenic spots and the consent of the guests, the guide may adjust your itinerary (such as adjusting the order of scenic spots) according to the weather, traffic and other conditions to ensure the smooth progress of the trip.
We reserve the right to change, postpone or cancel the itinerary due to damage to equipment and transportation, strike, sickness, theft, loss, accident, weather and other force majeure.
Please be responsible for the extra expenses caused by force majeure, such as traffic delay, strike, weather, aircraft, machine failure, flight cancellation or rescheduling.
For the safety of all passengers, please fasten your seat belt when you take the bus. If the passenger fails to wear a seat belt, the passenger shall bear the penalty.
During formula 1 2024/11/20-2024/11/24, we are not going to be able to go to these locations,Wynn/Horseshoe/Bellagio/MGM Grand/Virgin, because road closed.

Marvin and Leslie were top notch guides and I had an amazing time at the lower antelope Grand Canyon. I thought the hike was going to be longer and there was more time left but for some reason it was relatively short. The amount of stops and breaks was sufficient and vegetarian food was alright. I enjoyed the movies they played throughout the ride as well as the stories Marvin shared. My group was really great and we made it back to Vegas on time.

This is a long day but I have to give credit to the staff for making it all happen successfully and safely. From the early start to the late finish the staff politely kept us on time so we wouldn't miss our canyon walks while providing complimentary water, energy bars and later a turkey (or veg) sandwich. That said, what really kept me going was the humor and motivational steers from our host so a big thank you to the crew!
